# verygood chocolate Sydney

> Small-batch chocolate cakes made to order for birthdays, parties and gifting. Pre-order only. Pickup in Melrose Park, Sydney. No walk-in shop or delivery.

Official AU website: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com
Primary service area: Melrose Park, Sydney

## Ordering
- Choose a cake and options.
- Send a request so availability can be checked.
- Receive payment details after availability is confirmed.
- Collect by pre-arranged pickup in Melrose Park after final confirmation.

## Cakes
- Pave Chocolate Cake: A rich four-layer chocolate cake built for a dense, chocolate-forward bite. Instead of a light sponge-and-cream style, each layer is filled with smooth pave chocolate ganache, creating a substantial cake with deep chocolate flavour from the first slice to the last. From AUD 79. 6 inch serves 8, 7.5 inch serves 14, and 9 inch serves 22. Choose a size · dark chocolate only https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/pave-chocolate-cake
- Vanilla Fresh Cream Cake: Chocolate cake sheets layered with plain fresh cream for a clean, chocolate-forward cake without added fruit or flavoured fillings. From AUD 69. 6 inch serves 8, 7.5 inch serves 14, and 9 inch serves 22. Choose a size · Plain fresh cream between chocolate cake sheets https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/vanilla-fresh-cream-cake
- Buttercream Cake: Chocolate cake sheets layered and finished with Chocolate Buttercream. Choose a point colour to personalise the finish. From AUD 74. 6 inch serves 8, 7.5 inch serves 14, and 9 inch serves 22. Choose a size and point colour · Chocolate Buttercream between chocolate cake sheets https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/buttercream-cake
- Chocolate Cupcakes: Chocolate cupcakes for sharing, parties and easy gifting. Choose a half dozen or dozen, then select one finish for the whole box. From AUD 31. Choose a half dozen or dozen, then select Basic, Vanilla Fresh Cream, or Chocolate Buttercream. Choose a pack size and one finish for the whole box https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/chocolate-cupcakes
- Signature Gâteau au Chocolat: A rich rectangular gâteau au chocolat finished with dark chocolate. Simple, compact and easy to share or gift. AUD 45. Choose Basic finish, Extra chocolate +AUD 7, or Vanilla cream +AUD 10. Choose one finish option https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/signature-gateau-au-chocolat
- Lemon Cake: Lemon-shaped cakes filled with fresh lemon cream and finished with a floral decoration. From AUD 36. Boxes of 6, 8, 12 or 16. Choose a pack size and finishing mix. The 12-piece box is Most Popular. https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/lemon-cake
- Brownie Cheesecake: A 6 inch Brownie Cheesecake serving 8, with three finishing options. From AUD 55. Basic AUD 55, pave chocolate on top AUD 65, or full pave chocolate finish with one Eiffel Tower chocolate AUD 70. 6 inch serves 8 · three finishing options https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/brownie-cheesecake

## Kids cake classes
- Private, hands-on cake classes held in Melrose Park, Sydney on Saturdays and Sundays. Basic welcomes children from Kindy to Year 6; Advanced starts from Year 2.
- Base course/package prices: AUD 99–254.60.
- A Basic + Advanced package covers two separate weekend sessions and receives 5% off the base class fees.
- A 30-minute extension is AUD 20 per participant, per class and is not discounted.
- https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/classes
